sion":1,"chapter":4,"paragraph":112,"text":"苏天晴凑上前去，用银铃般悦耳的声音说出恶魔低语，"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c04","revision":1,"chapter":4,"paragraph":122,"text":"“要是不愿意的话，狐狐我可不会让它们松开哦。”苏天晴脸上的笑容更加灿烂。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":4,"paragraph":128},"chapters":[1,2,3,4],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":false,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":false,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":11,"returned":10},"truncation":{"page":true,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":"eyJ2ZXJzaW9uIjoxLCJxdWVyeSI6ImM4NTg5ZWE5NGZjZGJmMjY5MWY0MWQwOGMzZWRhNTVjOTgxOTQxNDRjMTQwZGI2OGM5ZjAwOWJkZjEwYTBmNzIiLCJvZmZzZXQiOjEwLCJjaGVja3N1bSI6ImQ4MWI3MWE5M2VlNzBjMDM1ODU1MzFhMmJjMzBjNGMxYzc1ZTVhZTk1MDExZDc4OThmOGMwMzZkYTM0ZTkxMGUifQ"},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-4","sourceManifest":"manifest:ab921696d519ac1a","knowledgeRevision":4,"readAt":{"chapter":4,"paragraph":129},"contentHash":"2123d98d1e4add30fc01cf4b64041aa9bb8c95ccce05a21d9e21e7aa2b744de8"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":4,"paragraph":128},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c04","revision":1,"chapter":4,"paragraph":121,"text":"“啊，对了，风信子小姐想不想跟狐狐我玩点游戏呢？要是你赢了的话我就把你放下来哟。”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c04","revision":1,"chapter":4,"paragraph":124,"text":"“什、什么游戏？”"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":4,"paragraph":128},"chapters":[1,2,3,4],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":2,"returned":2},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-4","sourceManifest":"manifest:ab921696d519ac1a","knowledgeRevision":4,"readAt":{"c
